description: Close an Oracle Watch monitored window early (idempotent; also works on an expired window) and return the summary of every signal issued inside it: poll counts, verdict distribution, and halt timestamps. Covered by the window purchase — no per-call charge. Authenticates with the one-time window token from the purchase.

windowToken.description: The one-time token returned at purchase (oww_<hex>)

name: oracle_watch_window_close
